privacyOptinText.message:
For this extension to work, you must agree to the collection of personal data.
We collect the addresses of the sites you visit, and also monitor the behavior on the pages you visit (time spent on the page, clicks, cursor movement and scrolling). All information is stored in a depersonalized form.
This information is used by us to combat fraudulent traffic and is not transmitted to third parties. Advertising through this extension is only possible if we are confident that you are using it honestly.
